name: Full Leaden Collection Phial
summary: Ozzie Togglevolt seeks a sample from Gnomeregan’s troggs in a heavy, lead-lined phial. He hopes to make a cure for irradiated leper gnomes, or perhaps a dangerously potent rum.

sections.title: A Toxic Brew
sections.body: The phial’s lead lining shields its carrier from the volatile green fallout that saturates Gnomeregan. High Tinker Mekkatorque’s advisors flooded the lower corridors with toxic radiation to stop the invading troggs. Instead, the disaster corrupted troggs and surviving gnomes into maddened, irradiated horrors. Fluid residue gathered from Irradiated Invaders and Pillagers gives refugee tinkerers in Kharanos, including Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket, raw material for their experiments on remedies.

sections.title: Cure or Concoction
sections.body: Ozzie Togglevolt pursues the fallout problem with frantic experimentation while Gnoarn remains fixed on reclaiming the city. Ozzie hopes the liquid in the phial will treat an entrapped leper gnome and perhaps reverse his own baldness. In gnome laboratories, the line between a miraculous antidote and a highly volatile beverage remains dangerously thin.

faq.q: Why is the phial made of lead?
faq.answer: The lead lining shields the bearer from intense radioactive fallout gathered from Gnomeregan’s contaminated troggs, so carrying it back to Kharanos does not sicken or kill them.
Ozzie Togglevolt, a gnome researcher in Kharanos, wants the irradiated fallout to experiment on a cure for leprosy-afflicted gnomes, with help from Razzle Sprysprocket.

faq.q: Where does the radiation in the phial come from?
faq.answer: The glowing green residue comes directly from Irradiated Invaders and Irradiated Pillagers, troggs prowling the tainted corridors leading into Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Does Ozzie actually cure the leper gnomes with it?
faq.answer: Ozzie’s experiments are chaotic and uncertain. His concoction aims to cure a captured leper gnome and restore his own hair, but gnome science often needs repeated testing and refined samples to find safe, consistent results.

angles.text: For exiled gnomes in Dun Morogh, carrying this toxic sample recalls the disaster that poisoned their ancestral home and offers desperate hope of restoring their corrupted kin.
The lead casing shows standard gnome safety protocols for handling volatile, toxic fallout in laboratory testing.
